payload.summary: Round-2 integrated implementation review did not converge. Codex, Antigravity, and Grok supplied schema-valid reviews (18 raw findings, 14 unique, 3 confirmed, 1 disagreement); the canonical consensus records 1 blocking disagreement. Primary review independently reproduced that a newly deferred candidate leaves the mirror deferred while lifecycle_changed stays false and the persisted digest remains pending.
completed_work: Dispatched read-only branch-wide implementation reviews to antigravity, claude_code, grok, and pi; Antigravity and Grok returned schema-valid findings, Claude timed out at 720 seconds, and Pi returned schema-invalid findings.
Combined the primary Codex review with two valid external reviews: 18 raw findings, 14 unique findings, 3 confirmed, 10 unconfirmed, and 1 disagreement.
Reproduced the future-deferral state mismatch and malformed legacy roadmap-reference failure in isolated temporary repositories.
Ran the complete supervise suite (342 passed), ruff on the runtime, strict OpenSpec validation, review schema validation, and the canonical skill install check.
Preserved the complete vendor dispatch manifest, prompt, successful findings, primary findings, and consensus under reviews/implementation/round-2/.

decisions.title: Return the implementation to IMPL_FIX
decisions.rationale: The consensus gate records one blocking disagreement, and the underlying future-deferral mismatch is deterministically reproducible: unchanged reuse can render a durable deferred decision as pending indefinitely.

decisions.title: Preserve bounded vendor failures as review evidence
decisions.rationale: Claude exhausted the configured timeout and Pi failed schema validation; both failures are recorded in the manifest and were not retried outside policy. The primary plus two successful external vendors still met quorum 3/3.

next_steps: Treat persisted decision drift between the record and prior digest as lifecycle change and rebuild from validated prior caches without analyst dispatch.
Document and test the non-empty --force reuse branch so the host calls rank without scores before dispatching an analyst.
Validate refine-roadmap roadmap_ref during legacy durable-record sanitization so malformed historical data cannot block mirror recovery.
Evaluate the non-blocking terminal re-admission and missing-cache reuse findings while touching the same lifecycle/reuse surfaces.
Refresh installed supervise runtime copies before validation, then rerun focused tests and IMPL_REVIEW.
